# JARVIS v2.3.6 Release Notes

### What's New in v2.3.6:

- **Instant Conversational Fast-Track & Semantic VAD:**
  - Intelligent real-time completion detection (`isUtteranceComplete`) across Hindi, Urdu, Hinglish, Arabic, and English.
  - Fast-tracks turn response generation on a natural ~150ms pause instead of forcing a 420ms–680ms wait for completed statements.
  - Dual-path endpointing: triggers turn commit directly upon complete transcript arrival and via the 20ms VAD audio frame loop.
  - Anti-cutoff guard preserves the full adaptive dynamic silence window (420ms–680ms) whenever trailing hesitation or conjunctions are detected.

- **Real-Time Gemini Live Interim ASR Streaming:**
  - Full ingestion support for `interimInputTranscription` and root-level transcript updates directly from Google Gemini Live WebSocket.
  - Smart hypothesis merging eliminates duplicate tokens and provides real-time streaming speech text without latency.

- **Enhanced Quran Tilawat & Tafseer Engine:**
  - Mandatory Ta'awwudh (*A'udhu billah*) & Tasmiyah (*Bismillah*) opening recitation before any Surah/Ayah tilawat.
  - Offline zero-latency playback for Surah Al-Fatiha and Surah Al-Baqarah (Verses 1–10) with cached multi-ayah streaming.
  - Flexible multi-ayah range detection (e.g., *"no 1 aayt se 10 tak"*, *"5 tak continue padho"*) and polite Tarjuma/Tafseer inquiry flow.

- **Loving Companion & UI Enhancements:**
  - Preserved girlfriend / loving tone warmth and affection during Quran tilawat, translations, and everyday conversation.
  - Interactive mic on/off tap button for easy manual toggling.
  - Cleaned up footer layout with Gemini version and power details repositioned cleanly at the bottom.
